name: grand_totals_comparable
purpose: Summarize the main year-on-year totals for the comparable store population.
intent: One row filtered to the comparable stores 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no] in {'ST4','ST1','ST3','ST2','ST5'}, returning the measures [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], [retail price current year], [retail price past year], and [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], with no grouping.
dax:
EVALUATE
CALCULATETABLE(
    ROW(
        "net revenue CURRENT", [net revenue CURRENT],
        "net revenue PAST", [net revenue PAST],
        "revenue Growth", [revenue Growth],
        "revenue growth %", [revenue growth %],
        "net qty CURRENT", [net qty CURRENT],
        "net qty PAST", [net qty PAST],
        "QTY Growth", [QTY Growth],
        "QTY GROWTH %", [QTY GROWTH %],
        "net bills CURRENT", [net bills CURRENT],
        "bills growth", [bills growth],
        "bills growth %", [bills growth %],
        "SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR", [SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR],
        "SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR", [SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR],
        "SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH", [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH],
        "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR],
        "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR],
        "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH],
        "retail price current year", [retail price current year],
        "retail price past year", [retail price past year],
        "RETAIL PRICE GROWTH", [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH]
    ),
    TREATAS(
        {"ST4","ST1","ST3","ST2","ST5"},
        'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]
    )
)

name: latest_complete_month_by_month_number
purpose: Identify the latest complete reporting month and show the monthly year-on-year comparison across the comparable store population.
intent: Summarize by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[Month] for the comparable stores 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no] in {'ST4','ST1','ST3','ST2','ST5'}, returning [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], [bills growth], and [bills growth %]; limit to 15 rows and sort by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[Month] DESCENDING so the most recent month number is first.
dax:
EVALUATE
TOPN(
    15,
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
        'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[Month],
        TREATAS({"ST4","ST1","ST3","ST2","ST5"}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]),
        "net revenue CURRENT", [net revenue CURRENT],
        "net revenue PAST", [net revenue PAST],
        "revenue Growth", [revenue Growth],
        "revenue growth %", [revenue growth %],
        "net qty CURRENT", [net qty CURRENT],
        "net qty PAST", [net qty PAST],
        "QTY Growth", [QTY Growth],
        "QTY GROWTH %", [QTY GROWTH %],
        "net bills CURRENT", [net bills CURRENT],
        "bills growth", [bills growth],
        "bills growth %", [bills growth %]
    ),
    'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[Month], DESC
)
